feasibility.note: Threshold is a documented planning guide, not an automatic hard stop -- train_lora.py always prints the measured numbers and requires the feasibility report to exist before proceeding.

epochs_rationale: LoRA is trained for exactly 2 epochs because of CPU compute limits: the measured feasibility run (v2, real training format) gave ~9.6 s/step, i.e. ~100.8 min for 3 epochs (range 83.5-118.6) versus ~67 min for 2 epochs. The epoch count was fixed BEFORE any LoRA result existed and was not chosen using test-set or challenge-set performance. It is a compute-driven limitation, not a tuned value.
